parameter.name: inputSource
parameter.description: Where the input comes from: 'Message Body' (default, the raw payload) or 'Expression' (read from sourceContent).

parameter.name: sourceContent
parameter.description: Input to process: an expression such as ${payload} (default), ${vars.x}, or a property. Falls back to the payload.

parameter.name: inputType
parameter.description: How the input is represented: TEXT or BINARY (base64).

parameter.name: charset
parameter.description: Charset for TEXT input. Default: UTF-8.

parameter.name: encryptionConfigKey
parameter.description: Name of the PGP Public Key connection holding the recipient's key.

parameter.name: symmetricKeyAlgorithm
parameter.description: AES_256 (default), AES_192, AES_128, CAMELLIA_256, CAMELLIA_192, CAMELLIA_128, TWOFISH, CAST5, TRIPLE_DES, BLOWFISH, IDEA.

parameter.name: armor
parameter.description: ASCII-armor the output. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: integrityCheck
parameter.description: Add an integrity (MDC) packet. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional file name embedded in the literal-data packet.

parameter.name: responseVariable
parameter.description: Name of the variable to store the operation output.

parameter.name: overwriteBody
parameter.description: Replace the message body with the operation output. true or false (default).
